name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-style full-stack Email Job Scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,worker,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "api,worker,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
